hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash set -euo pipefail
# --- Config --- dictionary_api="${api}" role_arn="arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl" container_name="dictionaryetl" container_cm_dir="/opt/local/hpds" local_data_dir="data"
# --- Pre-flight checks --- for cmd in aws jq csvgrep csvcut docker curl; do command -v "$cmd" >/dev/null || { echo "missing: $cmd" >&2; exit 1; } done
# --- Assume AWS Role (simple parse) --- aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 3600 \ --role-arn "$role_arn" \ --role-session-name "s3-test" > assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | tr -d ' ,"') export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | tr -d ' ,"') export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | tr -d ' ,"')
# --- Download Required Files --- mkdir -p "$local_data_dir" aws s3 cp "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/resources/Managed_Inputs.csv" "$local_data_dir/Managed_Inputs.csv" --no-progress aws s3 cp "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/general/hpds/javabin/columnMeta/columnMeta.csv" "$local_data_dir/columnMeta.csv" --no-progress
# --- Clear Credentials --- unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
# --- Build studies.json (skip header, only phs*, ready=Yes, processed=No) --- csvgrep -c "Data is ready to process" -m "Yes" "$local_data_dir/Managed_Inputs.csv" \ | csvgrep -c "Data Processed" -m "No" \ | csvcut -c "Study Identifier" \ | tail -n +2 \ | grep -E '^phs[0-9]+' \ | jq -Rsc 'split("\n") | map(select(length>0))' > studies.json
echo "studies.json:" cat studies.json echo
# --- Ensure target dir exists in container and copy columnMeta.csv --- docker exec "$container_name" mkdir -p "$container_cm_dir" docker cp "$local_data_dir/columnMeta.csv" "${container_name}:${container_cm_dir}/columnMeta.csv" echo "Copied columnMeta.csv into ${container_name}:${container_cm_dir}/columnMeta.csv"
# --- Build payload.json safely with jq --- jq -n --argjson studies "$(cat studies.json)" ' { includeDefaultFacets: true, clearDatabase: false, studies: $studies }' > payload.json
# --- DEBUG POST (replace your POST section with this while debugging) --- payload_file="payload.json" resp_body="loader_response.json" resp_headers="loader_response.headers" curl_trace="curl.trace"
echo "Payload:" jq . "$payload_file" || cat "$payload_file" echo
# Pick one URL to test explicitly while debugging: test_url="${dictionary_api%/}/load/initialize" echo "POST -> $test_url" echo
# cURL with full diagnostics http_code="$( curl -v -i \ --trace-ascii "$curl_trace" --trace-time \ --no-progress-meter \ --max-time 0 \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d @"$payload_file" \ -o "$resp_body" \ -D "$resp_headers" \ -w '%{http_code}' \ "$test_url" 2>curl.verbose )" || true
echo echo "HTTP status: $http_code" echo "Saved: $resp_headers, $resp_body, curl.verbose, $curl_trace"
echo echo "Response headers:" sed -n '1,200p' "$resp_headers"
echo echo "Response body (first 200 lines):" sed -n '1,200p' "$resp_body"
# Helpful parses echo echo "Server header:"; grep -i '^server:' "$resp_headers" || true echo "Content-Type:"; grep -i '^content-type:' "$resp_headers" || true echo "Location:"; grep -i '^location:' "$resp_headers" || true
# --- Copy Error Report From Container --- # vars container_name="dictionaryetl" container_cm_dir="/opt/local/hpds" file="columnMetaErrors.csv"
# exists (any size) if docker exec "$container_name" sh -lc "[ -f \"$container_cm_dir/$file\" ]"; then docker cp "$container_name:$container_cm_dir/$file" "./$file" docker exec "$container_name" sh -lc "rm -f \"$container_cm_dir/$file\"" else # so the archive doesn't fail touch $file fi
# --- Cleanup in container --- docker exec "$container_name" rm -f "${container_cm_dir}/columnMeta.csv" || true echo "Removed columnMeta.csv from container."
# --- Artifacts --- echo "Saved:" echo " - studies.json" echo " - payload.json" echo " - loader_response.json" echo " - HTTP status: ${http_code}"
